today.headline: AI will never be funny on purpose.
today.body: The machine can recombine a million jokes and still not know why any of them land. Humour needs a victim, a risk, and a shared flinch — three things a model is built to avoid. So when an AI makes you laugh, ask who actually wrote the punchline.

lobby.title: Remote work killed mentorship
lobby.desc: You can't absorb judgement over a video call. A generation is flying blind.

lobby.title: Privacy is already over
lobby.desc: You traded it years ago. The fight now is who profits, not whether it's gone.

lobby.title: Reading fiction makes you worse at facts
lobby.desc: Narrative trains you to want a tidy arc. Reality doesn't have one.

lobby.title: Most 'data-driven' decisions aren't
lobby.desc: The numbers get picked after the gut already chose. Dashboards are theatre.
